dataset.description: Original Figure 5 neural/kinematic inputs from Figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.28326998 and GSK26-public revision 815b610b3beddfed5a3abf611d3a465ab9e4ce5c. Authenticate all ten source session datafiles, derived RADICaL inputs and release/member identities; inventory records and code pins do not establish complete payload/reference manifests.

cohort.description: All five imaging mice cfa17, cfa19, cfa20, cfa22 and cfa24, one original M1 and one S1 session each, all original eligible trials and all 24 ordered joints. Authenticate source date/area joins, including the later cfa24 M1 date. Ten anonymous structs alone are insufficient; the distinct intervention cohort is outside this decoder primary.

split.description: Preserve five repetitions of ten source trial partitions and all 50 held-out fits per session. Models 1-10 hold permutation residues 1-9 then 0; bind original trial order, complementary train/test identities and once-per-repeat coverage. Seed 240926 alone is insufficient because PCA and six source model configurations advance shared RNG. No newly chosen split substitutes.

inputs.description: Original instantaneous RADICaL rates from the top 100 source lift-modulated cells predict all 24 joint angles. Bind original ZETA cell selection, observation horizon and feature ordering. Candidate methods may improve the decoder but may not gain extra neurons, biological observations or target exposure. Relevant author alternative/control branches keep their distinct original inputs.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source joint-angle interpolation and 15-ms Gaussian smoothing, lift-locked -100 to +400 ms on the 10-ms grid (51 timepoints), unsmoothed RADICaL rates and pre-CV PCA retaining 90% of neuron count. Authenticate source ordering and exposure of ZETA/PCA instead of silently substituting train-only processing or permitting extra test-target access; controls retain branch-specific processing.

metric.description: Per joint and original fit, VE = 1 - Var(y - yhat)/Var(y), using MATLAB sample-variance semantics over concatenated held-out trial timepoints. Retain negative VE and resolve source zero-variance handling. This is not SSE/SST R-squared; constant prediction offsets leave VE unchanged. Exact complete numeric references and qualified agreement/improvement rules remain unresolved.

aggregation.description: Preserve the complete 5-mouse x 2-area x 50-fit x 24-joint panel. plotVEAll takes median over 50 fits per joint, then median of those joint medians for proximal joints 1-7 and distal joints 8-24 within each mouse/area. Compare differences of original summaries, not median paired-score differences or a pooled scalar. Keep all four area/group outputs, mouse pairing and companions; favorable subsets cannot win.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Figure 5 held-out VE panel and source proximal/distal within-mouse M1/S1 reductions

published_baseline.description: The complete source per-fit/joint/mouse VE panel and original source reductions are not recovered as qualified full-precision references. Graphical summaries do not supply an exact numeric scalar baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Source fig5_analysis -> loadDecode -> decode -> cvRegress provides the author route, but complete authentic ten-session original-fold computation and numeric parity are unqualified. Resolve the strongest relevant author configuration under identical input scope; a phase-template reference is calibration only.

minimum_effect.rationale: Recover source performance/reference variability and justify meaningful improvement on the complete original panel before selecting a threshold. No new scalar, universal positive delta or maximized biological effect is supplied.

uncertainty.method: Qualify a complete-family paired comparison preserving source summaries and all mouse/area outputs. Repeated CV fits and joints do not increase the five-mouse biological sample size. Resolve multiplicity, overlap dependence and meaningful effect before final candidate evaluation.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Five imaging mice; M1/S1 sessions are paired, and joints, trials/timepoints and repeated fits are dependent observations.
uncertainty.rationale: Original structured support and dependence must be preserved; decision criteria may not be chosen after seeing final candidate outputs.

Independently calibrate complete published and strongest relevant source-author reference performance on identical original support.

Freeze candidate/code, source identities, meaningful complete-family comparison policy and cumulative budgets before final evaluation. Candidate reproduction success is not an improvement prerequisite.

current_sota.description: Comparison targets a named original-paper result; no current frontier comparison or SOTA result is claimed.

episode.improvement_loop: No final-test feedback under this unqualified proposal. After qualification, iterate using source-matched training and declared validation feedback with cumulative accounting.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method/code, source support and preprocessing exposure, original partitions, author baseline, complete-family scientific comparison and cumulative budgets before final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Independently execute the frozen candidate on complete original held support and compare source-native output/metric families with qualified published and strongest relevant author references; report both outcomes independently for each information condition.
episode.baseline_policy: Compare both qualified published performance and the source-equivalent rerun of the strongest relevant original-author method on identical instantaneous input scope. Main ridge/RADICaL, bagged, lagged and residual branches are not interchangeable; the local phase template is not an author comparator.
